verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents webhooks that send HTTP POST requests to configured URLs whenever memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized. That gives real event-driven triggers, but the user must build the receiving logic elsewhere. There is no evidence of a native rules engine, conditional filters, or built-in actions. Missing for 10: user-defined rules/conditions within Mem0, built-in automated actions beyond outbound notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook behavior.
